alarms.action: Conveyor stops and a jam alarm is raised until it is reset
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while the conveyor runs
alarms.name: Jam alarm

conflicts.authoritative: Parameter sheet (for values) / Narrative (for intended logic)
conflicts.narrative_says: If entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while the conveyor runs, the conveyor stops and a jam alarm is raised.
conflicts.parameter_sheet_says: jam_time is 5.0 s using timer T10.
conflicts.program_says: The logic for the jam alarm (setting M190 based on T10 and PE-1002) is completely missing.

interlocks.effect: Inhibits the conveyor motor from running

steps.entry: Auto mode is active AND no ST10 fault is present
steps.exit: Auto mode is lost OR an ST10 fault becomes active
steps.name: Conveyor Run
